datasets.title: US State Boundaries
datasets.description: State boundary polygons (Census TIGER), topology-simplified for fast client-side rendering. Useful for choropleth maps and administrative aggregation examples from Chapter 5.

datasets.title: US County Boundaries
datasets.description: County boundary polygons with population and demographic attributes, topology-simplified for fast client-side rendering. Useful for choropleth maps, spatial joins, and administrative aggregation examples from Chapter 4.

datasets.title: North American Stadiums
datasets.description: Point dataset of 151 North American sports venues (MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS) with team, league, division, and coordinates. Used in Chapter 3 to demonstrate querying CSV files on S3 with Amazon Athena.
datasets.source: MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS / Manually compiled

datasets.title: US Postal Addresses (sample)
datasets.description: 500 synthetic US postal address records with names, companies, and contact info. Table-only reference data (no coordinates) for CSV-on-S3 and Athena examples from Chapter 3.

datasets.title: Texas Oil & Gas Wells (RRC)
datasets.description: Point dataset of oil and gas well locations across Texas, with operator, zone status, and county. Used alongside the KGFCU field-ops examples in Chapters 4-5.

datasets.title: Utah Oil & Gas Wells
datasets.description: Point dataset of oil and gas well locations across Utah, with operator, well status, and county.
datasets.source: Utah Division of Oil, Gas and Mining

datasets.title: Natural Gas Compressor Stations
datasets.description: Point dataset of natural gas compressor stations nationwide, with operator and status. Real energy infrastructure matching the book's field-ops chapters.

datasets.title: US Wind Turbines (USWTDB)
datasets.description: Nationwide wind turbine locations with project name, manufacturer, model, capacity, and year installed. Sampled for smooth client-side rendering.

datasets.title: EV / Alt-Fuel Stations
datasets.description: Nationwide electric and alternative-fuel vehicle charging/fueling station locations, with network and fuel type. Sampled for smooth client-side rendering.
datasets.source: US DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center

datasets.title: Colorado Electric Transmission Lines
datasets.description: Electric transmission line segments across Colorado. Demonstrates line-geometry rendering and utility network examples from Chapter 5.

datasets.title: US Wind Resource Class
datasets.description: Wind power class regions (1-7, higher is windier) used for siting wind energy projects. Complements the wind turbine point dataset above.

datasets.title: US Oil Refineries
datasets.description: Point dataset of 155 US petroleum refineries with capacity, owner/operator, and NAICS classification. Real energy infrastructure matching the book's oil & gas examples.

datasets.title: LNG Import/Export Terminals
datasets.description: US liquefied natural gas import/export terminal locations, with owner, operator, and storage/regasification capacity.

datasets.title: US Crude Oil Pipelines
datasets.description: Crude oil pipeline route dataset (236 segments) with operator and pipeline name. Line-geometry energy infrastructure spanning the continental US.
